ValidationRule.description: Show False or Blank needs something to show: at least one Inverse value (Static Text, Icon, Image, Badge/Pill Text or Hover Text). Otherwise the component draws only the generic fallback icon.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Show_False_or_Blank__c && ISBLANK( Inverse_Static_Text__c ) && ISBLANK( Inverse_Icon_Value__c ) && ISBLANK( Inverse_Image__c ) && ISBLANK( Inverse_Badge_Pill_Text__c ) && ISBLANK( Inverse_Hover_Text__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Show False or Blank is checked but no Inverse value is set. Add an Inverse Icon, Static Text, Image, Badge/Pill Text or Hover Text, or clear the checkbox.
